heading: T_wcet improvement
text:
### T_wcet improvement [LNOG.5.2]

Under `realtime`, the TMS term is bounded (`n_ids ≤ DS_TMS_INLINE = 16`)
but present.  Under `realtime: true` with `logical: false`, T_wcet
becomes:

```
T_wcet(realtime, logical=false) =
    T_init_cycle
  + n_asserts   × T_assert
  + n_retracts  × (c_wm_remove + c_alpha × A_s + c_beta_ridx × joined × k)
  + T_tick_ttl(max_expired_per_tick)
  + T_run(max_fires)
```

Compared to `realtime` alone:
- `c_tms × n_ids` (≤ `c_tms × 16`) removed from every retraction.
- No cascade: the retraction of one fact cannot cause the retraction of
  further facts via TMS.  Every `T_retract` call is self-contained.

Adding `linear_scan: false`, `joined` in the beta_ridx term is
also bounded to J_max... but see [LNOG.6] — this combination bans
multi-pattern rules, so the beta_ridx term is absent entirely.  Retract
reduces to:

```
T_retract(realtime, linear_scan=false, logical=false) = c_wm_remove
                                                      + c_alpha × A_s
```

This is the minimum achievable retraction cost for a Rete engine: a
hash-table remove from the WM and removal from the alpha memory arrays.
